jobs.title: Professional Learning Facilitator (Contract)
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love . Professional Learning Facilitator (Contract) MagicSchool is seeking experienced educators to facilitate engaging professional learning experiences that help schools and districts integrate AI thoughtfully and effectively. Professional Learning Facilitators (PLFs) deliver live virtual and/or in-person sessions that support educators in understanding MagicSchool tools, best practices, and instructional applications. This is a contract role with flexible hours based on demand. This role is seasonal in nature. Contractors should expect periods of sustained high volume - most notably during the summer and peak moments of the school year - interspersed with slower periods. Availability during peak times is essential. We will be prioritizing candidates who have daytime availability in their time zone and are available a minimum of 10 hours per week. We are prioritizing candidates in North Carolina and South Carolina, and will also strongly consider candidates in TX, FL, NY, NJ. Primary Purpose Deliver consistent, high-quality MagicSchool professional learning using established content while building facilitation expertise, platform fluency, and confidence in virtual PD environments. Typical Facilitation Scope Introductory and foundational virtual PD sessions Platform overviews and core MagicSchool workflows Co-facilitation or shadowing in advanced sessions Lower-stakes, standardized engagements Key Responsibilities Deliver pre-designed MagicSchool PD sessions with fidelity Implement light customization using approved content and facilitation guides Represent MagicSchool as a trusted thought partn

jobs.title: Telecom security trainer
jobs.description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces. Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub). Job Description Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide. Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies. This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning. Responsibilities Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives. Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team. jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
